players.product: HDD suspensions (Disk Drive Suspension business) for high-capacity HDDs used in AI-related applications and data centers

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year April 2025-March 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 816,879 million (+1.9%), operating income JPY 45,784 million (-12.2%), ordinary income JPY 52,189 million (-10.0%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 27,862 million (-42.2%; extraordinary items turned to a JPY 1,881 million loss mainly on higher impairment losses, and the tax burden rose to 43.1% from 16.2%). Capital expenditure JPY 47,675 million. Sales by region: Japan JPY 396,897 million, USA JPY 128,110 million, Thailand JPY 174,368 million, other JPY 117,503 million. No external customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 816,879 million (+1.9%); operating income JPY 45,784 million (-12.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: DDS (Disk Drive Suspension) segment, fiscal year April 2025-March 2026 (annual securities report): demand for high-capacity HDDs for data centers increased and HDD suspension sales volume rose year on year, so sales were JPY 126,753 million (+13.7%); operating income was JPY 26,058 million (-2.3%) on higher fixed costs. Operating-income drivers: volume / mix +73 oku yen, selling-price improvement and price cooperation -35 oku yen, FX -17 oku yen, fixed costs -30 oku yen, material prices +2 oku yen (oku = 100 million yen). By sales origin: Japan JPY 41,445 million, Asia JPY 85,307 million. Management states world HDD production increased year on year and, with more high-capacity HDDs for data centers, total demand for its suspensions increased.
quarterly_data.figure: DDS sales JPY 126,753 million (+13.7%); operating income JPY 26,058 million (-2.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's view of the DDS business (annual securities report): demand for high-capacity HDDs stayed firm on the expansion of AI and cloud services and demand for HDD suspensions, its main product, remained at a high level; it expects HDD capacities to keep rising and the functions required of suspensions to become more advanced, so maintaining competitiveness through continued technology development and productivity gains is a key issue. It will pursue rationalisation such as introducing AI-based AOI (automated optical inspection) and expand production capacity appropriately.

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company forecast and mid-term plan targets (annual securities report): for April 2026-March 2027 (FY2027; the company's "fiscal 2026", final year of its 2026 Mid-term Plan) the company forecasts net sales JPY 8,600 oku, operating income JPY 590 oku, ordinary income JPY 640 oku and net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 450 oku, ROE 10.0% and ROIC 8.0% (oku = 100 million yen), against the plan's targets of JPY 8,500 oku sales and JPY 520 oku operating income (April 2025-March 2026 actual: JPY 8,168 oku and JPY 457 oku). It plans higher sales in both the automotive and the information-and-communications markets. Main premises of the plan targets: global vehicle production 98 million units, HDD production 118 million units, JPY 145 per US dollar.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 forecast: net sales JPY 8,600 oku; operating income JPY 590 oku; target premise HDD production 118 million units

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex plan (annual securities report): the company plans JPY 58,700 million of capital expenditure for April 2026-March 2027: DDS JPY 15,400 million (expansion and renewal of production equipment), suspension springs JPY 10,800 million, seats JPY 7,900 million, precision parts JPY 11,000 million, industrial machinery and others JPY 8,300 million, corporate JPY 5,300 million (R&D equipment). Fiscal year April 2025-March 2026 actual DDS capex was JPY 5,641 million, mainly HDD suspension production equipment at the parent, NHK Spring's Dongguan subsidiary (China) and NHK Spring Thailand.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex plan JPY 58,700 million, of which DDS JPY 15,400 million; FY2026 DDS capex JPY 5,641 million

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): in HDDs the company began mass production of CLA/TSA suspensions for CMR 26-28TB drives carrying 10-11 disks and continues to supply TSA suspensions for heat-assisted recording; it expects high-capacity HDDs, with or without assisted recording, to raise recording density per disk mainly through higher data-track density, which requires more precise head positioning and better suspension resonance characteristics, so it is developing and optimising suspension designs for the next models. DDS R&D spending was JPY 2,283 million, within group R&D of JPY 24,676 million (3.0% of net sales).
quarterly_data.figure: CMR 26-28TB with 10-11 disks; DDS R&D JPY 2,283 million; group R&D JPY 24,676 million

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, fiscal year April 2025-March 2026 (annual securities report; sales / operating income): industrial machinery and others JPY 124,535 million (+8.1%) / JPY 7,294 million (-23.3%) - demand for semiconductor process parts keeps increasing, but depreciation rose on capex for future demand for semiconductor process parts and metal substrates (segment capex JPY 13,307 million, mainly the Komagane plant extension and metal-substrate equipment); management expects strong semiconductor-market demand to continue and is raising capacity under the two-plant setup of the Isehara and Miyata plants. Precision parts JPY 105,612 million (+3.5%) / JPY 3,651 million (-14.9%) - HDD mechanism-part volumes rose on higher demand for data-center high-capacity HDDs, plus consolidation of the Indian subsidiary. Suspension springs JPY 167,417 million (-1.0%) / JPY 727 million (+56.6%); seats JPY 292,561 million (-3.7%) / JPY 8,052 million (-28.3%). The company will build a new automotive suspension spring plant in western India to meet rising global demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Industrial machinery and others JPY 124,535 million (+8.1%); precision parts JPY 105,612 million (+3.5%)
